name: Trapezius
description: A large diamond-shaped muscle spanning the neck, shoulders, and upper back.
function: Elevates, retracts, and rotates the scapula and supports the neck and posture.

name: Deltoids
description: The rounded, triangular muscles capping each shoulder.
function: Abduct, flex, and rotate the arm at the shoulder joint.

name: Pectoralis Major
description: The large fan-shaped muscle of the upper chest.
function: Flexes, adducts, and medially rotates the arm; drives pressing movements.

name: Biceps Brachii
description: The two-headed muscle on the front of the upper arm.
function: Flexes the elbow and supinates the forearm.

name: Triceps Brachii
description: The three-headed muscle on the back of the upper arm.
function: Extends the elbow; stabilizes the shoulder during pressing.

name: Forearm Flexors
description: The muscle group on the palm side of the forearm.
function: Flex the wrist and fingers and contribute to grip strength.

name: Rectus Abdominis
description: The paired vertical muscle running down the front of the abdomen.
function: Flexes the trunk and stabilizes the pelvis and core.

name: Obliques
description: The muscles along the sides of the abdomen.
function: Rotate and laterally flex the trunk and support the core.

name: Latissimus Dorsi
description: The broad muscle of the mid and lower back.
function: Extends, adducts, and medially rotates the arm; drives pulling movements.

name: Gluteus Maximus
description: The largest muscle of the buttocks.
function: Extends and externally rotates the hip; powers standing, climbing, and sprinting.

name: Quadriceps
description: The four-headed muscle group on the front of the thigh.
function: Extends the knee and flexes the hip.

name: Hamstrings
description: The muscle group on the back of the thigh.
function: Flex the knee and extend the hip.

name: Gastrocnemius
description: The prominent two-headed muscle of the calf.
function: Plantarflexes the foot and flexes the knee; drives push-off in gait.

name: Skull
description: The bony structure of the head that encloses the brain.
function: Protects the brain and forms the framework of the face.

name: Vertebral Column
description: The spine — a flexible column of stacked vertebrae.
function: Supports the trunk, protects the spinal cord, and enables movement.

name: Rib Cage
description: The bony cage formed by the ribs, sternum, and thoracic spine.
function: Protects the heart and lungs and supports breathing mechanics.

name: Clavicle
description: The collarbone connecting the arm to the trunk.
function: Struts the shoulder outward and transmits force from arm to skeleton.

name: Humerus
description: The long bone of the upper arm.
function: Supports the upper arm and provides attachment for arm and shoulder muscles.

name: Radius & Ulna
description: The paired bones of the forearm.
function: Support the forearm and enable rotation of the wrist and hand.

name: Pelvis
description: The basin-shaped ring of bone connecting the spine to the legs.
function: Transfers load from the trunk to the legs and anchors hip muscles.

name: Femur
description: The thigh bone — the longest and strongest bone in the body.
function: Supports body weight and anchors the powerful muscles of the thigh.

name: Tibia & Fibula
description: The paired bones of the lower leg.
function: Support body weight and form the ankle joint with the foot.

name: Lungs
description: The paired spongy organs of the chest that exchange gases with the blood.
function: Draw in oxygen and release carbon dioxide; their capacity underpins aerobic fitness.

name: Diaphragm
description: The dome-shaped muscle beneath the lungs that separates the chest from the abdomen.
function: Contracts to draw air into the lungs; the primary muscle of breathing and core stability.

name: Trachea
description: The windpipe — the airway connecting the throat to the bronchi and lungs.
function: Conducts air to and from the lungs and filters and warms incoming breath.

name: Heart
description: The muscular pump at the centre of the chest that circulates blood.
function: Pumps oxygenated blood to the body; adapts to endurance training by stroke-volume gains.

name: Aorta
description: The body's largest artery, arching up from the heart before running down the trunk.
function: Carries oxygen-rich blood from the heart into the arterial network.

name: Vascular Network
description: The branching system of arteries and veins that reaches every tissue.
function: Delivers oxygen and nutrients and returns blood to the heart; adapts with aerobic training.
